name: The Owl House
description: Luz, a self-assured teenage human girl, accidentally stumbles upon a portal to a magical new world where she befriends a rebellious witch, Eda, and an adorably tiny warrior, King.

videos.title: Welcome to Hexside!
videos.overview: Principal Bump welcomes you to Hexside School of Magic and Demonics! Their top priority is keeping students safe, providing amazing food in the cafeteria, and give students the support they need!

videos.title: Eda's Cursed Brush
videos.overview: Luz teaches Eda how to make fine art out of anything! But when Luz uses Eda's cursed pencil, things go awry!

videos.title: Paint Scare!
videos.overview: Luz and King head off to the woods to paint scenic nature! But they can't seem to escape a dark mysterious figure in their painting!

videos.title: Art Lessons with Luz
videos.overview: King is fascinated by Luz's drawings, but Hooty loses his cool when he can't tell the difference between a drawing and real life!

videos.title: Coven Lovin Soap Opera
videos.overview: Luz watches her favorite romantic soap opera "Bleeding Hearts" and King slowly becomes addicted!

videos.title: A Lying Witch and a Warden
videos.overview: Luz, a self-assured teenage girl, accidentally stumbles upon a portal to a magical world where she befriends a rebellious witch, Eda, and an adorably tiny warrior, King. In order to get home, Luz must help them with a mission.

videos.title: Witches Before Wizards
videos.overview: When an ancient wizard gives Luz a map for a mystical quest, she wonders if she is actually a Chosen One.

videos.title: I Was a Teenage Abomination
videos.overview: Luz sneaks into the local magic school to help a friend and makes a new enemy in the process.

videos.title: The Intruder
videos.overview: Luz and King have to defend the Owl House from a mysterious intruder.

videos.title: Covention
videos.overview: Luz's lesson about witch covens goes awry when she finds herself thrust into a witch's duel.

videos.title: Hooty's Moving Hassle
videos.overview: When Luz, Willow and Gus accidentally animate the Owl House, the house runs amok around Bonesborough.

videos.title: Lost in Language
videos.overview: While checking out the library, Luz's pranks lead to unintended consequences.

videos.title: Once Upon a Swap
videos.overview: A simple disagreement leads to a complex situation when Eda, King, and Luz triple-down on a wager.

videos.title: Something Ventured, Someone Framed
videos.overview: When Gus sneaks Luz into Hexside School to present at the Human Appreciation Society, Luz sees a side of the school she didn't expect.

videos.title: Escape of the Palisman
videos.overview: When an adventure with Eda's staff goes awry, Luz and her friends have to earn the staff back from a mysterious forest creature, or lose the staff forever.

videos.title: Sense and Insensitivity
videos.overview: When King becomes a bestselling author, he learns a valuable lesson in reading the fine print.

videos.title: Adventures in the Elements
videos.overview: Luz needs to learn a new spell, so Eda takes her to the most magical place on the island to train.

videos.title: The First Day
videos.overview: During Luz’s first day of Magic School, curiosity gets the best of her, and she finds herself thrown into the Delinquent Track, where she’s not allowed to learn magic.

videos.title: Really Small Problems
videos.overview: King confides in a carnival fortuneteller who makes his dream come true, but it comes at a cost.

videos.title: Understanding Willow
videos.overview: Luz, Willow and Amity take a trip down memory lane.

videos.title: Enchanting Grom Fright
videos.overview: Luz experiences Grom, Hexside’s version of Prom, and it’s not what she expects.

videos.title: Wing It Like Witches
videos.overview: Not your average underdog story.

videos.title: Agony of a Witch
videos.overview: On a school field trip to the mysterious Emperor’s Castle, Luz strays from the group and into danger.

videos.title: Young Blood, Old Souls
videos.overview: Luz’s skills as a witch are put to the test when she attempts the impossible.

videos.title: Separate Tides
videos.overview: Luz feels guilty about Eda losing her powers, so she sets sail in search of a lucrative bounty to help the Owl House.

videos.title: Escaping Expulsion
videos.overview: When Amity's parents get Luz, Willow and Gus expelled from Hexside, Luz strikes a dangerous deal with them to get back into school.

videos.title: Echoes of the Past
videos.overview: King's delusions of grandeur lead Luz, Lilith, and Hooty to a dangerous new island.

videos.title: Keeping Up A-fear-ances
videos.overview: Eda gets an unwelcome visit from a family member who puts a strain on everyone in the Owl House.

videos.title: Through the Looking Glass Ruins
videos.overview: Gus tries to impress a group of cool kids from Glandus High, while Luz and Amity journey into the most dangerous section of the library.

videos.title: Hunting Palismen
videos.overview: It’s Palisman Pairing Day at Hexside, but Luz doesn’t match with a Palisman of her own and soon finds herself on an unexpected journey with a foe.

videos.title: Eda's Requiem
videos.overview: A special witch from Eda’s past enlists her in a rebellion against the Emperor.

videos.title: Knock, Knock, Knockin' on Hooty's Door
videos.overview: Hooty tries to help King, Eda and Luz with their problems, but it doesn’t go as planned.

videos.title: Eclipse Lake
videos.overview: When Luz gets sick with the Common Mold, it's up to Amity to find an important ingredient for the portal door - but Amity's not the only one on its trail.

videos.title: Yesterday's Lie
videos.overview: Luz thinks she's found a way back home. But is she ready for what she'll find on the other side?

videos.title: Follies at the Coven Day Parade
videos.overview: In the aftermath of her trip home, Luz takes on daring rescue missions during the Coven Day parade.

videos.title: Elsewhere and Elsewhen
videos.overview: Luz is desperate for more information about Philip Wittebane, the creator of the portal door. With Lilith's help, she sets off on a journey for the ages.

videos.title: Any Sport in a Storm
videos.overview: Hunter goes uncover at Hexside for his most important mission yet. Willow becomes determined to succeed at an exciting new sport.

videos.title: Reaching Out
videos.overview: Amity wants to prove herself to her father, and Luz thinks she's found the perfect way to do it: Underground Witch Duels.

videos.title: Them's the Breaks, Kid
videos.overview: Eda tells a story from her teen years: the day she met Raine Whispers.

videos.title: Hollow Mind
videos.overview: A magical mishap transports Luz and Hunter into a new mindscape - and this one is a twisted nightmare.

videos.title: Edge of the World
videos.overview: King's quest to uncover his past leads to shocking revelations and horrifying truths.

videos.title: Labyrinth Runners
videos.overview: When the Emperor's coven comes to Hexside, Gus teams up with an unlikely ally.

videos.title: O Titan, Where Art Thou
videos.overview: Eda and Luz scramble to face the day of unity. King faces his true identity.

videos.title: Clouds on the Horizon
videos.overview: Everyone on the Isles prepares to celebrate the Day of Unity.

videos.title: King's Tide
videos.overview: The Day of Unity begins.

videos.title: Thanks to Them
videos.overview: After months of trying, Luz and her friends make a daring attempt to return to the Demon Realm.

videos.title: For the Future
videos.overview: Luz and her friends race against Belos to confront the Collector and save the Boiling Isles.

videos.title: Watching and Dreaming
videos.overview: The fate of the Boiling Isles rests on the shoulders of a human, a cursed witch and a little King.
